chargeback.description: The identifier of the Chargeback resource that this chargebackDocument relates to.

allOf.description:
The type of the file that holds this chargebackDocument. 
The value is set when the file is properly integrated, otherwise will be null.

<details>
<summary>Valid Values</summary>

- `jpg` - **JPG file**
- `jpeg` - **JPEG file**
- `gif` - **GIF file**
- `png` - **PNG file**
- `pdf` - **PDF file**
- `tiff` - **TIFF file**
- `tif` - **TIF file**

</details>

ref.description: The reference of this chargeback document is stored as a text string and must be between 1 and 100 characters long, with the value being set when the file is properly integrated, otherwise it will be null.

description.description:
The description of this chargebackDocument. 
This field is stored as a text string and must be between 1 and 100 characters long.

name.description: The name of this chargeback document holds the real file name used by the user, stored as a text string and must be between 1 and 100 characters long.

allOf.description:
The source of the document.
<details>
<summary>Valid Values</summary>
- `merchant` - **Merchant.** 
- `issuer` - **Issuer.** 
</details>

<details>
<summary>Valid Values</summary>

- `0` - **Active**
- `1` - **Inactive**

</details>

<details>
